notes.title: Update Veiled Whispers
notes.notes:
We’ve made the decision to move the release of Veiled Whispers to 2026. This wasn’t easy, but it’s the right step. We’re committed to delivering a truly immersive and atmospheric horror experience – and that means giving the game the time it needs to reach its full potential.

For more details and behind-the-scenes updates, visit our website:
👉 Schimion Games

Thank you for your patience and continued support!
– Daniel
